LLD/SystemDesign/IntheWild/WhyOurEksPods.title: EKS OOMKilled: glibc Thread Arenas & MALLOC_ARENA_MAX
LLD/SystemDesign/IntheWild/WhyOurEksPods.description: How glibc thread arena fragmentation caused OOMKilled Python pods on Amazon EKS, how we diagnosed it, and why MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 fixed the memory growth.
